shared_tokenizer: jhu-clsp/mmBERT-base tokenizer used by the multilingual Laya base
token_count: compact sorted JSON request; no special tokens; counted outside timed interval
timed_operations: input preparation, tokenization, synchronized prediction and response formatting; API includes HTTPS round trip and service response
rate_definition: sum of shared input tokens divided by sum of measured elapsed seconds
decision_rate_definition: number of measured calls divided by sum of measured elapsed seconds
